text: The purpose of this report is to recommend that the ceremonial name of "Heroes' Way" be assigned to Canterbury Place, North York. A ceremonial street dedication does not change the official street name or address information. It does result in the installation of special signage along the selected street. Economic Development and Culture consulted with Transportation Services during the preparation of this report.

North York Community Council: 1. Assigned the ceremonial name "Heroes' Way" to Canterbury Place, North York. 2. Directed the General Manager, Transportation Services to erect signage marking "Heroes' Way".
